title: Project responsibility and scheduling
description: Task ownership and dependency checks for project plans.

rules.instruction: When using RACI, identify the people who do the work, the person who owns each decision, those who must give input and those who need the outcome.
rules.verification: Walk through one handoff with the people listed. Resolve any deliverable with no accountable owner or overlapping authority before work starts.

rules.instruction: For a dependency-driven schedule, record predecessors, durations and the basis for each estimate. Identify the path that determines the finish milestone and update it when dependencies change.
rules.verification: Trace the critical path to the finish milestone with project owners. Test one schedule delay and check that its effect agrees with the recorded float.
